# Skeleton

Simulate the presence of an existing element whilst the page loads with simplified representations.
See [Skeleton guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/skeleton/design)

<Canvas of={SkeletonStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={SkeletonStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Complex layouts

Skeletons can be used for complex components
